newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Bank rises on planned bond recall.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Bank rises on planned bond recall.

text.p: Shares in Sumitomo Bank Ltd rose in Thursday morning trade, supported by Wednesday's announcement that the bank would offer to purchase any and all of its 3.125 percent dollar-denominated convertible bonds maturing on March 31, 2004, traders said.
As of 0037 GMT, the share price was up 40 yen at 2,020 yen. Turnover was 1.147 million shares, the fifth heaviest trading volume on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Sumitomo Bank said on Wednesday that the offer was designed to strengthen its financial condition by trimming interest rate payments as well as its total debt.
